name: – Andrzej Halicki – After § 21 – Am 42
title: REPORT on general guidelines for the preparation of the 2026 budget, Section III – Commission
part_text: 21a. Reaffirms the importance of freedom of expression and freedom of the press as the best guarantee against totalitarian trends; considers, furthermore, that the ‘Citizens, Equality, Rights and Values’ programme has become primarily a tool for ideological propaganda and that, in a context of budgetary difficulties for the Member States, its budget must be considerably reduced; considers that the ‘Citizens, Equality, Rights and Values’ programme should benefit only Member States and not candidate countries;
